checklist.title: EIP-712 Box Types Schema Validation at Trust Boundary
checklist.detection_procedure: When a boxed value is received at the trust boundary (EDGE-RECV-TO-VALIDATE), verify that the types schema conforms to valid EIP-712 type definitions before any processing. Invalid schemas must be rejected immediately to prevent type confusion attacks.
executable_checks: Submit a boxed value with malformed types schema (missing required fields)
Submit a boxed value with circular type references
Submit a boxed value with invalid type names (reserved keywords, special characters)
Submit a boxed value with mismatched type definitions
Verify all invalid schemas are rejected before box structure validation proceeds
checklist.notes: This is a trust boundary check. The types schema validation is critical for preventing type confusion between outer and inner schemas in EIP-712 boxed values.

checklist.title: EIP-712 Box Type Isolation Enforcement
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify that inner type definitions in a boxed value cannot reference any types from the outer struct's type schema. Attempt to create a boxed value where inner types reference outer types and confirm the violation is detected.
executable_checks: Create a box with inner type referencing an outer type definition
Verify type isolation check detects the violation
Confirm state transitions to TYPE-ISOLATION-VIOLATED
Test with multiple levels of type nesting
Verify the isolation check occurs before any hash computation
checklist.notes: Type isolation prevents type confusion attacks where attackers manipulate schema interpretation by mixing inner and outer type definitions.

checklist.title: EIP-712 Box Contents Rendering to User
checklist.detection_procedure: After successful validation, verify the wallet renders the decoded boxed contents to the user in human-readable form, not as opaque hex data. The user must be able to understand what they are signing.
executable_checks: Submit a valid boxed value for signing
Verify wallet displays decoded inner structure to user
Confirm hex data is NOT shown as the primary representation
Test with complex nested types
Verify all fields are clearly labeled and readable
checklist.notes: User visibility is critical for informed consent. Showing opaque hex data would enable phishing attacks where users unknowingly sign malicious structured data.

checklist.title: EIP-712 Type Schema Immutability After Signing
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify that type schemas in boxed values are immutable once used for signing. Test that versioning must be handled at the application level, not by modifying existing schemas.
executable_checks: Sign a message with a specific box type schema
Attempt to modify the schema for the same type
Verify signature verification fails with modified schema
Confirm schema hash remains constant
Test that versioning requires new type names, not schema modification
checklist.notes: Schema immutability is essential for signature validity. If schemas could change, signatures would become ambiguous and potentially exploitable.

checklist.title: Fulu Blob Limit Enforcement and Block Rejection
checklist.detection_procedure: If blob commitment count exceeds the epoch-specific limit (15 or 21), verify the block is rejected immediately and marked as invalid. No partial processing should occur.
executable_checks: Submit a block with 16 blob commitments in epoch [412672, 419072)
Verify block is rejected (expected limit: 15)
Submit a block with 22 blob commitments in epoch >= 419072
Verify block is rejected (expected limit: 21)
Confirm rejected blocks are not propagated to peers
checklist.notes: Blob limit enforcement is consensus-critical. Accepting oversized blocks would cause chain splits between upgraded and non-upgraded nodes.

checklist.title: Fulu Proposer Lookahead O(1) Performance
checklist.detection_procedure: After proposer lookahead update, verify get_beacon_proposer_index returns in O(1) time via state.proposer_lookahead[slot % SLOTS_PER_EPOCH]. Measure execution time and confirm constant-time access.
executable_checks: Update proposer lookahead for current epoch
Call get_beacon_proposer_index for various slots
Measure execution time - should be constant regardless of slot
Verify array index calculation: slot % SLOTS_PER_EPOCH
Confirm no linear search or complex computation occurs
checklist.notes: O(1) proposer lookup is a performance optimization. Degradation to linear time could enable DoS attacks during block proposal.

checklist.title: EIP-5792 Batch Call ID Uniqueness Validation
checklist.detection_procedure: When wallet_sendCalls is received at the trust boundary, verify the app-provided ID is unique (up to 4096 bytes) per sender per application. Duplicate IDs must be rejected to prevent ID collision attacks.
executable_checks: Submit a wallet_sendCalls request with a specific ID
Submit a second request with the same ID from the same sender/app
Verify duplicate ID is detected and rejected
Test ID uniqueness is scoped per application
Verify ID length limit (4096 bytes) is enforced
checklist.notes: Trust boundary check for ID uniqueness. Duplicate IDs could enable replay attacks or batch status confusion.

checklist.title: EIP-5792 Successful Batch Execution Status
checklist.detection_procedure: After successful batch execution where all calls confirmed onchain without reverts, verify batch status is set to 200. Any call revert must prevent status 200.
executable_checks: Submit a batch with multiple valid calls
Execute batch and confirm all calls onchain
Verify batch status transitions to 200
Submit a batch where one call reverts
Confirm status is NOT 200 (should be 500 or 600)
checklist.notes: Status 200 indicates complete success. Incorrect status reporting could mislead applications about transaction finality.

checklist.title: EIP-5792 Atomic Execution Requirement Enforcement
checklist.detection_procedure: When atomicRequired=true and atomic execution is unsupported, verify the wallet rejects with error 5760 rather than silently executing non-atomically. Silent fallback would violate user intent.
executable_checks: Submit wallet_sendCalls with atomicRequired=true
Simulate wallet without atomic execution support
Verify request is rejected with error code 5760
Confirm NO non-atomic execution occurs
Test error message clearly states atomicity is unavailable
checklist.notes: Atomic execution requirement must be respected. Non-atomic execution when atomicity is required could lead to partial state changes violating user expectations.

checklist.title: EIP-5792 Chain ID Format Validation
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify chain ID in wallet_sendCalls is a hex string with 0x prefix and no leading zeros. Malformed chain IDs must be rejected at validation.
executable_checks: Submit request with chain ID missing 0x prefix
Submit request with leading zeros (e.g., 0x001)
Submit request with non-hex characters
Verify all malformed formats are rejected
Confirm valid hex format (e.g., 0x1, 0x89) is accepted
checklist.notes: Chain ID format validation prevents cross-chain replay attacks and ensures consistent chain identification.

checklist.title: EIP-2831 Cancellation Transaction Construction
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify a cancellation transaction is constructed as a self-send (from == to) with value = 0 and empty data, using the same nonce as the original. Any deviation must be rejected.
executable_checks: Request cancellation of a pending transaction
Verify cancel tx has from == to (same address)
Confirm value is exactly 0
Verify data field is empty
Confirm nonce matches original pending transaction
checklist.notes: Cancellation transaction structure is standardized to ensure recognition by providers and prevent accidental fund transfer.

checklist.title: EIP-2831 Transaction Sender Authorization
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify only the transaction sender can replace their own pending transaction. Third parties must not be able to replace others' transactions through nonce reuse.
executable_checks: Create a pending transaction from address A
Attempt to submit replacement with same nonce from address B
Verify replacement is rejected (unauthorized)
Confirm only address A can submit valid replacement
Test with speed-up, cancel, and generic replacement
checklist.notes: Sender authorization prevents transaction hijacking. Unauthorized replacements would enable griefing and potential fund theft.

checklist.title: MODEXP Precompile Length Field Parsing
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify input to MODEXP precompile is parsed as three big-endian uint256 length fields from the first 96 bytes. Invalid or missing bytes must result in well-defined behavior.
executable_checks: Call MODEXP with input < 96 bytes
Verify zero-padding is applied to missing bytes
Call MODEXP with input >= 96 bytes
Confirm first 96 bytes are parsed as length fields
Verify big-endian interpretation is correct
checklist.notes: Length field parsing is the entry point. Incorrect parsing would cause all subsequent computation to operate on wrong data.

checklist.title: MODEXP Gas Cost Minimum Floor
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify gas cost is at least 200 (minimum floor), calculated as max(200, complexity * iterations / GQUADDIVISOR). Very small inputs should still cost 200 gas.
executable_checks: Call MODEXP with minimal input sizes (all lengths = 0)
Verify gas cost is exactly 200
Call MODEXP with small inputs where formula < 200
Confirm gas cost is floored at 200
Call MODEXP with large inputs where formula > 200
Verify formula result is used (not 200)
checklist.notes: Minimum gas floor prevents underpricing of small MODEXP operations that still require fixed overhead.

checklist.title: MODEXP Empty Result Handling
checklist.detection_procedure: When both base_length and modulus_length are zero, verify the precompile returns an empty byte string (not an error or zero-filled result).
executable_checks: Call MODEXP with base_length = 0, modulus_length = 0
Verify result is empty byte string (length 0)
Confirm no error or revert occurs
Test with various exp_length values (should not affect result)
Verify gas is still charged normally
checklist.notes: Empty result case is an edge case that must be handled consistently to avoid consensus divergence.

checklist.title: EIP-7577 Commit Scope Indicator Validation
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify a pull request modifying an EIP contains a scope indicator ([Mm]ajor:, [Mm]inor:, or [Pp]atch:) in its commit message. Missing scope must block merge.
executable_checks: Submit PR with commit message lacking scope indicator
Verify PR merge is blocked
Submit PR with valid scope ([Major:], [minor:], [PATCH:])
Confirm merge is allowed
Test case-insensitive scope detection
checklist.notes: Scope indicator is required for automatic version increment. Missing scope prevents proper EIP versioning.

checklist.title: Fork Criteria Ordering Enforcement
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify fork ordering places BLOCK_NUMBER forks before TIMESTAMP forks before UNSCHEDULED forks. Incorrect ordering would cause activation sequence errors.
executable_checks: Define multiple forks with different criteria types
Verify BLOCK_NUMBER forks are evaluated first
Confirm TIMESTAMP forks are evaluated second
Verify UNSCHEDULED forks are evaluated last
Test with mixed activation thresholds
checklist.notes: Fork ordering is consensus-critical. Incorrect ordering could cause forks to activate in wrong sequence, breaking upgrade paths.

checklist.title: Constantinople Fork Irreversible Activation
checklist.detection_procedure: After the Constantinople fork block is processed, verify the chain irreversibly operates under Constantinople rules. No reorg should revert to pre-Constantinople rules.
executable_checks: Process block at Constantinople activation height
Verify all Constantinople EIPs are active
Attempt to create a reorg to pre-Constantinople state
Confirm Constantinople rules remain enforced
Test blocks immediately after activation use new rules
checklist.notes: Fork activation irreversibility is fundamental to consensus. Reversible forks would enable chain split attacks.

checklist.title: Prague EVM Exceptional Halt Gas Consumption
checklist.detection_procedure: On ExceptionalHalt, verify all remaining gas is consumed (evm.gas_left = 0) and output is cleared. Partial gas consumption would violate EVM semantics.
executable_checks: Trigger exceptional halt (e.g., invalid opcode)
Verify gas_left == 0 after halt
Confirm output buffer is cleared
Test with various remaining gas amounts
Verify gas refund counter is not incremented
checklist.notes: Exceptional halt gas consumption is a security mechanism. Partial consumption could enable gas estimation attacks.

checklist.title: Prague Contract Creation Code Validation
checklist.detection_procedure: After contract creation, verify deployed code does not start with 0xEF prefix (reserved for EOF). Code with 0xEF prefix must be rejected.
executable_checks: Deploy contract with code starting with 0xEF00
Verify deployment fails
Deploy contract with code starting with 0xEF01
Confirm rejection
Deploy contract with code starting with 0xEE (not reserved)
Verify deployment succeeds
checklist.notes: 0xEF prefix is reserved for EOF format. Allowing 0xEF deployment would conflict with future EOF upgrades.

checklist.title: Prague Contract Code Size Limit
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify deployed contract code does not exceed MAX_CODE_SIZE (24576 bytes). Oversized code must be rejected at deployment.
executable_checks: Deploy contract with code exactly 24576 bytes
Verify deployment succeeds
Deploy contract with code 24577 bytes
Confirm deployment fails
Test code size check occurs after construction
Verify constructor return data is measured
checklist.notes: Code size limit prevents bloated contracts that could slow down block validation. Exceeding limit is a hard consensus failure.

checklist.title: Prague EVM Trace Function Side-Effect Isolation
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify the evm_trace function has no side effects on execution state. Tracing must not alter EVM behavior, gas consumption, or state changes.
executable_checks: Execute contract with tracing enabled
Execute same contract with tracing disabled
Verify identical state changes in both cases
Confirm gas consumption is identical
Test that trace data collection does not modify stack/memory
checklist.notes: Trace isolation is critical for debugging reproducibility. Tracing side-effects would make bugs non-reproducible between traced and non-traced execution.

checklist.title: EIP-7823 MODEXP Parameter Length Validation
checklist.detection_procedure: At trust boundary, verify MODEXP precompile (address 0x05) validates length_of_BASE, length_of_EXPONENT, and length_of_MODULUS are each <= 1024 bytes before computation proceeds. Oversized parameters must be rejected.
executable_checks: Call MODEXP with length_of_BASE = 1025 bytes
Verify call fails with gas consumed
Call MODEXP with length_of_EXPONENT = 1025 bytes
Confirm rejection
Call MODEXP with length_of_MODULUS = 1025 bytes
Verify rejection
Call MODEXP with all lengths = 1024 bytes
Confirm execution succeeds
checklist.notes: CRITICAL boundary check. Length validation prevents DoS attacks via computationally expensive large MODEXP operations.

checklist.title: EIP-7823 MODEXP Violation Gas Penalty
checklist.detection_procedure: When a MODEXP input violation is detected, verify all gas allocated to the call is consumed before returning an error. This economically penalizes the caller.
executable_checks: Call MODEXP with oversized parameter and 100000 gas
Verify all 100000 gas is consumed
Call MODEXP with violation and 50000 gas
Confirm all 50000 gas is consumed
Verify error status is returned after gas consumption
checklist.notes: Full gas consumption penalizes attackers attempting to probe limits or launch DoS attacks with oversized MODEXP calls.

checklist.title: Whisper Envelope Structure Validation
checklist.detection_procedure: At trust boundary, validate message envelope received from peer has correct structure [Expiry(4), TTL(4), Topic(4), Data(var), Nonce(8)] before acceptance. Malformed envelopes must be rejected.
executable_checks: Send envelope with missing Expiry field
Verify rejection
Send envelope with wrong field sizes
Confirm rejection
Send envelope with fields in wrong order
Verify rejection
Send correctly structured envelope
Confirm acceptance
checklist.notes: Envelope structure validation is the first line of defense. Malformed envelopes could trigger parser vulnerabilities.

checklist.title: Whisper Envelope Rejection Handling
checklist.detection_procedure: After an envelope fails validation, verify it is silently dropped without notifying the sender, unless the failure constitutes a severe protocol violation warranting peer disconnection.
executable_checks: Send envelope with invalid PoW
Verify envelope is dropped silently (no response)
Send envelope with malformed structure
Confirm peer disconnection occurs (severe violation)
Monitor no error messages are sent back to sender
Verify only severe violations trigger disconnection
checklist.notes: Silent dropping prevents information leakage to attackers probing the network. Only severe violations should trigger disconnection.

checklist.title: EIP-7732 Builder Signature Verification
checklist.detection_procedure: At trust boundary, verify the builder's BLS signature on the execution payload header is valid before the proposer includes it in the beacon block. Invalid signatures must be rejected.
executable_checks: Submit builder bid with invalid BLS signature
Verify bid is rejected by proposer
Submit bid with signature from wrong key
Confirm rejection
Submit bid with valid signature
Verify acceptance and inclusion in block
Test signature verification occurs before payment deduction
checklist.notes: CRITICAL trust boundary check. Invalid builder signatures could enable unauthorized payload commitments and payment theft.

checklist.title: EIP-7732 PTC Threshold for FULL Status
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify a slot is marked as FULL (payload included) only if at least 256 of 512 PTC members attest that the payload is present and blob data is available. Fewer attestations must result in EMPTY status.
executable_checks: Simulate slot with 255 PTC attestations
Verify slot is marked EMPTY (below threshold)
Simulate slot with 256 PTC attestations
Confirm slot is marked FULL (at threshold)
Simulate slot with 257 attestations
Verify FULL status
Test attestations missing blob_data_available flag
checklist.notes: PTC threshold (256/512 = 50%) is consensus-critical. Incorrect threshold could cause chain splits between honest nodes.

checklist.title: EIP-684 Address Collision Handling
checklist.detection_procedure: If a collision is detected (nonce > 0 OR code length > 0 at target address), verify the creation is treated as an invalid opcode: all gas consumed, state changes reverted, zero address returned to caller.
executable_checks: Attempt CREATE to address with nonce > 0
Verify all gas is consumed
Confirm state changes are reverted
Verify zero address is returned to caller
Attempt CREATE to address with existing code
Confirm identical handling (invalid opcode treatment)
checklist.notes: CRITICAL collision handling. Incorrect handling could enable address collision attacks where malicious code is deployed at expected addresses.

checklist.title: EIP-4788 Beacon Root Storage Layout
checklist.detection_procedure: After the system call to the beacon roots contract, verify the block timestamp is stored at index (timestamp % 8191) and the beacon root is stored at index (timestamp % 8191) + 8191. Incorrect storage layout would break queries.
executable_checks: Trigger beacon root system call with timestamp T
Verify timestamp stored at index (T % 8191)
Verify beacon root stored at index (T % 8191) + 8191
Test with multiple timestamps to confirm ring buffer
Query stored root and verify retrieval uses correct indices
checklist.notes: Storage layout is critical for beacon root queries. Incorrect indices would cause query failures or return wrong roots.

checklist.title: ECRECOVER Parameter r Range Validation
checklist.detection_procedure: At trust boundary, verify the ecrecover parameter r satisfies 0 < r < SECP256K1N. Values outside this range must cause an empty return (not revert).
executable_checks: Call ecrecover with r = 0
Verify empty return (not revert)
Call ecrecover with r = SECP256K1N
Confirm empty return
Call ecrecover with r > SECP256K1N
Verify empty return
Call ecrecover with valid r (0 < r < SECP256K1N)
Confirm recovery proceeds
checklist.notes: Parameter r range validation prevents invalid signature inputs. Empty return (not revert) is critical for backward compatibility.

checklist.title: EIP-7514 Activation Churn Limit Enforcement
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify the number of validator activations per epoch never exceeds MAX_PER_EPOCH_ACTIVATION_CHURN_LIMIT (8), regardless of the total validator set size. Exceeding this limit would violate consensus.
executable_checks: Queue 20 validators for activation in a single epoch
Verify only 8 are activated (limit enforced)
Confirm remaining 12 are deferred to next epoch
Test with large validator set (> 200,000)
Verify limit remains 8 (not scaled with set size)
checklist.notes: CRITICAL consensus invariant. Churn limit prevents rapid validator set growth that could threaten network stability.

checklist.title: EIP-7934 Oversized Block Rejection
checklist.detection_procedure: After block size validation, verify a block with RLP-encoded size > MAX_RLP_BLOCK_SIZE (8,388,608 bytes) is rejected and marked invalid. No partial processing should occur.
executable_checks: Receive block with RLP size 8,388,609 bytes
Verify block is rejected immediately
Confirm block is marked invalid
Verify block is not propagated to peers
Test rejection occurs before expensive validation (signatures, state)
Measure that rejection happens in early validation stage
checklist.notes: CRITICAL DoS protection. Early rejection of oversized blocks prevents resource exhaustion from malicious peers.

checklist.title: EIP-7801 Etha Handshake Validation
checklist.detection_procedure: At trust boundary, validate peer's etha handshake for networkId, genesis hash, and forkId compatibility before establishing the protocol connection. Incompatible handshakes must be rejected.
executable_checks: Receive handshake with mismatched networkId
Verify connection is rejected
Receive handshake with wrong genesis hash
Confirm rejection
Receive handshake with incompatible forkId
Verify rejection
Receive valid handshake
Confirm connection establishment
checklist.notes: Handshake validation prevents connection to incompatible networks. Weak validation could enable eclipse attacks.

checklist.title: EIP-2929 Access Set Persistence on Success
checklist.detection_procedure: When a call context succeeds, verify all access set modifications made within that scope persist in the parent context. Access sets must not be reverted on success.
executable_checks: Create nested call that accesses cold address
Verify address is added to access set
Complete nested call successfully
Confirm address remains in parent access set
Test subsequent access to same address is warm (100 gas)
Verify access set modifications persist across call boundaries
checklist.notes: Access set persistence is critical for gas pricing consistency. Losing access set data on success would cause warm accesses to be incorrectly charged as cold.

checklist.title: EIP-3855 PUSH0 Stack Overflow Gas Consumption
checklist.detection_procedure: A PUSH0-triggered stack overflow must consume all remaining gas, revert all state changes in the call frame, and return failure. Partial gas consumption is invalid.
executable_checks: Execute PUSH0 when stack depth = 1024
Verify stack overflow error
Confirm all remaining gas is consumed
Verify state changes are reverted
Confirm call returns failure status
Test with various remaining gas amounts
checklist.notes: Stack overflow gas consumption is a security mechanism. Partial consumption could enable gas estimation attacks.

checklist.title: Keccak Hash Function Arbitrary Input Handling
checklist.detection_procedure: At trust boundary, verify hash functions accept any valid bytes/bytearray input without length limits. The Keccak sponge construction must handle arbitrary-length inputs without crashing.
executable_checks: Hash empty input (0 bytes)
Verify computation succeeds
Hash very large input (100 MB)
Confirm computation completes without error
Hash input with all zero bytes
Verify deterministic output
Test inputs with various byte patterns
checklist.notes: Hash function robustness is critical. Crashes or errors on untrusted input would enable DoS attacks.

checklist.title: EIP-7825 Transaction Gas Limit Validation
checklist.detection_procedure: At trust boundary, validate transaction's gasLimit against the cap of 16,777,216 (2^24) at both mempool acceptance and block validation stages. Excessive gasLimit must be rejected.
executable_checks: Submit transaction with gasLimit = 16,777,216
Verify acceptance into mempool
Submit transaction with gasLimit = 16,777,217
Confirm rejection at mempool
Include oversized tx in block
Verify block is invalid
Test enforcement at both mempool and block validation
checklist.notes: CRITICAL DoS protection. Gas limit cap prevents unbounded block validation time from single transactions.

checklist.title: Ethash Proof-of-Work Difficulty Verification
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify the final PoW hash is computed as keccak256(seed_hash || mix_digest). If this hash is <= the target difficulty, the block passes PoW verification; otherwise it must be rejected.
executable_checks: Compute PoW hash for block with valid nonce
Verify hash <= target difficulty (block accepted)
Compute PoW hash for block with invalid nonce
Confirm hash > target difficulty (block rejected)
Test boundary case: hash exactly equals target
Verify acceptance (<=, not <)
checklist.notes: CRITICAL consensus rule. Incorrect difficulty verification would enable mining attacks and chain instability.
